manifest.objective: minimum worst-case unit action count, strong finite-horizon policies
manifest.timing: Fresh subprocess per cell. Compilation, planner construction, root bound and search timed. Interpreter/module startup and policy replay reported separately, excluded equally. Timeout retains completed phase results; never interpreted as infeasible.
manifest.selection: All four published sizes in BTS/BTCS, at H=n and H=n-1; declared resource extensions at n=4,8,12,16 with fixed-k failure (3,0) and boundary-feasible (n-2,2).
manifest.caveat: Two closely related domains: first scaling pilot, not a representative suite or published-planner comparison.
